name: Ammonite shell
notes: A fossil, weathered out of the rock: canon inlays the Board of the Chess of Fate with fossilised ammonites, so this is a material with a reputation before it is a material with a use. The black ones are not worked by anybody sensible. Taken from the ground, not from the living ammonites of the lava fields -- it was won from them until 1 October 2026, which made a fossil that never renews into something you took off an animal, and left Sura teaching a pendant on Dwarka from a shell almost nobody ever saw.
sources: Vedic Mythology and Version Controlled Tectonic Drift
